official.deadline_note: Two-stage calendar: presentation of the call to the FCM community 28 September - 2 October 2026; project and supervisor submission 5 - 16 October 2026; admitted projects circulated 2 - 6 November; student registration 9 - 20 November 2026; evaluation 30 November - 11 December 2026; definitive awards December 2026; scholarships start 1 February 2027.
official.status_note: Stage 1 (research projects and supervisors) is open from 5 to 16 October 2026 for FCM teacher-researchers; student registration follows from 9 to 20 November 2026, with definitive awards in December 2026 and scholarships starting 1 February 2027.
benefits: 210 clock hours of training: a 10-hour Research Methodology Course plus 200 hours of project execution, within a maximum of six consecutive months
Formative experience covering hypothesis and objective formulation, methodological planning, research ethics, results analysis and oral and written presentation of scientific work
Academic avales for students who reach the minimum score but are not awarded one of the 20 scholarships, allowing the formative experience without stipend
eligibility: Regular student of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria or Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud at the FCM UNCUYO
Have passed at least the first complete year of the degree (as minimo, el primer ano completo de la carrera)
Apply to a research project submitted by an FCM teacher-researcher and admitted at the first stage, individually or as a pair
requirements: Students apply only to projects and supervisors admitted and circulated after the first-stage evaluation
Apply individually (choosing from the admitted projects) or as a pair (student plus an already-agreed supervisor); neither modality has priority, bonus or guaranteed award
Complete the 10-hour Research Methodology Course and 200 hours of project execution within a maximum of six consecutive months
Attend the final obligatory in-person presentation and oral defence of the work, held 14 - 18 June 2027
documents: Bases of the Programa de Becas de Investigacion para Estudiantes, Convocatoria 2026-2027 (published on the programme page)
Anexos 1 to 7 published with the call on the programme page
selection_criteria: First stage: projects and supervisors must reach the minimum score set for admission at the evaluation by the corresponding advisory commission; only admitted projects are circulated for student application
Students reaching the minimum score who are not awarded one of the 20 scholarships may receive an academic aval to carry out the formative experience without stipend
coverage: 20 formative research scholarships worth 210 clock hours each (10-hour methodology course plus 200-hour project)

Project development over a maximum of six consecutive months starting 1 February 2027: methodology course 1 - 5 February, project execution from 8 February, final presentation jornada 14 - 18 June 2027
application_method: Stage 1: FCM teacher-researchers submit research projects to the corresponding advisory commission, 5 - 16 October 2026
Admitted projects and supervisors are circulated 2 - 6 November 2026
Students register 9 - 20 November 2026, individually or in pairs, to the admitted projects
Student evaluation runs 30 November - 11 December 2026, with definitive awards in December 2026
official.application_route: Watch for the admitted-projects list (circulated 2 - 6 November 2026), then register as a student between 9 and 20 November 2026 to an admitted project, individually or as a pair.
official.citizenship_residency: Restricted to regular students of the Facultad de Ciencias Medicas, Universidad Nacional de Cuyo (Mendoza, Argentina)
official.international_eligibility: Not open to external or international applicants - only regular FCM UNCUYO students of the three named degrees
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Open only to students of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria and Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud at the FCM UNCUYO
official.research_requirement: The scholarship is executed inside an admitted research project led by an FCM teacher-researcher, with 200 hours of project work and a final oral defence
official.duration: 210 clock hours (10-hour methodology course plus 200-hour project) over a maximum of six consecutive months from 1 February 2027
official.description: The FCM UNCUYO Programme of Research Scholarships for Students brings regular students of Medicine, Nursing and health-technician degrees into faculty research projects from early in their degrees, combining a 10-hour Research Methodology Course with 200 hours of supervised project work under the faculty's Direccion de Investigacion y Relaciones Institucionales.

tuition_coverage / living_cost_coverage / travel_coverage - the award is a formative research grant and pays no fees or living costs
verification.notes: The FCM UNCUYO call announcement and the programme's bases page were both read on 2026-10-10; the 20 scholarships, 210 clock hours, six-month limit, two-stage process, full calendar from the 5 - 16 October project window to the 14 - 18 June 2027 final jornada, and the 'sin estipendio' aval provision were all confirmed on the faculty's own domain.

applicant_utility.summary: You cannot apply directly: a faculty researcher must first get a project admitted in the 5 - 16 October 2026 stage, and only then can students register (9 - 20 November 2026) to the circulated list - so your real task in October is talking to potential supervisors. The award is formative, not financial: no stipend amount is published anywhere, and students who miss out on the 20 places can still get an academic aval to do the same 210 hours without a stipend. Plan around a six-month commitment starting 1 February 2027 and the obligatory in-person defence between 14 and 18 June 2027.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Medicine, Nursing and health-technician students at FCM UNCUYO who have finished their first year and want early, supervised research experience in health sciences.
application_readiness_checklist: Identify an FCM teacher-researcher whose project might be admitted in the 5 - 16 October stage and offer to join early
Confirm you have passed the first complete year of your degree - second-year students are the sweet spot
Decide between individual application (pick from the circulated project list) and the pair modality; neither gets preference
Watch for the admitted-projects circulation between 2 and 6 November 2026
Register between 9 and 20 November 2026 before evaluation runs 30 November - 11 December
Block the calendar: methodology course 1 - 5 February 2027, project from 8 February, defence 14 - 18 June 2027
common_rejection_risks: Waiting for a student application window that opens only after projects are admitted - by then the shortlist of projects is fixed
Applying without a first full year of the degree completed
Being outside the three eligible degrees (Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermeria, Tecnicos Asistenciales en Salud) at FCM
Assuming the pair modality gives an edge - the page states explicitly it does not
Missing the obligatory final presentation and oral defence, which is part of the 210 hours
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Everything: no stipend amount is published, and the award covers no tuition, living or travel costs - the value is the training hours and research experience.
document_audit: The bases and annexes 1 - 7 are published as downloadable files on the programme page - read the annexes, since they carry the formats, not the announcement
Pair applicants need a pre-agreed supervisor; individual applicants choose from admitted projects only
Applications are not a single national portal - they follow the FCM's own stages and circulation dates
alerts: The two-stage design means the real deadline for students is 20 November 2026, but the projects they can join were fixed a month earlier
Only 20 scholarships exist across the whole faculty
The award carries no published monetary value - do not budget around a stipend figure from any other source
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Supervisors submit projects first (5 - 16 October 2026), admitted projects are circulated (2 - 6 November), students then register (9 - 20 November) and are evaluated (30 November - 11 December) before December awards and the 1 February 2027 start.
